scope.claim: one deterministic local C malloc/free/realloc semantic comparison between separately attested ordinary C-backed and nondefault Rust-native libc artifacts, plus two source-faithful nonlocal realloc requirements that can become musl differentials only after their exact fixtures and runtime evidence are activated
scope.purpose: Preserve the ordinary libc artifact before native-mimalloc-shadow selection, then run the same normalized public C trace through both explicitly selected dynamic libc artifacts and record exact semantic matches or named known reds. The two named nonlocal realloc cases are required source-faithful pinned-musl 1.2.6 differentials: their exact fixtures must run through musl and the selected native artifact with identical required streams.

backends.selection: snapshot target/debug/libc.so before native-mimalloc-shadow is built
build crabc-libc with native-mimalloc-shadow after the ordinary artifact is snapshotted

semantic_cases.reason: The ordinary C-backed artifact returns a freeable but non-16-byte-aligned zero-size result, while the selected native shadow returns a freeable 16-byte-aligned result. Both preserve the fixture's incoming errno. This is a recorded public-C ABI red, not an accepted musl-equivalence result.

The ordinary C-backed artifact returns a distinct freeable 16-byte-aligned zero-size replacement, while the selected native shadow returns a distinct freeable but non-16-byte-aligned replacement. Both preserve the fixture's incoming errno. This is a recorded public-C ABI red, not an accepted musl-equivalence result.

expected.stdout: native mimalloc shadow foreign realloc ok

musl_differential_required_cases.reason: This one synchronized live-owner foreign realloc is a required source-faithful pinned-musl differential. An intentional-divergence or native-only acceptance is forbidden.

expected.stdout: native mimalloc owner exit realloc ok

musl_differential_required_cases.reason: This one serialized post-owner-exit realloc is a required source-faithful pinned-musl differential. An intentional-divergence or native-only acceptance is forbidden.

intentionally_blocked_cases.reason: General foreign-worker free routing remains outside this bounded matrix. The named `foreign-worker-realloc` fixture above is not part of this block: it is a required pinned-musl differential.

General owner-exit, deferred-release, and cross-owner routing remain outside this bounded matrix. The named `post-owner-exit-realloc` fixture above is not part of this block: it is a required pinned-musl differential.
The existing native_mimalloc_shadow_abi integration target owns weak binding, DSO JUMP_SLOT, and selected archive checks. This matrix uses one dynamically linked executable per artifact.
Those are allocator implementation details, not stable C ABI semantic facts, and comparing them would falsely require the Rust port to reproduce private layout choices.

execution.compiler: crabc-cc from the installed owned crabc sysroot
execution.runtime_library_selection: LD_LIBRARY_PATH contains exactly the directory holding the selected backend libc.so after inherited loader overrides are removed, and the fixture carries no RPATH or RUNPATH that could select another libc.so

pinned_musl_oracle.provenance: The pinned Docker image builds musl 1.2.6 from the SHA-256-verified upstream release under /opt/musl-1.2.6 and exposes its wrapper as musl-gcc; the host/system musl is not an oracle.

link_provenance.reason: The selected libc.so has no DSO SONAME, so a direct filesystem input would encode its path in DT_NEEDED. The matrix instead disables sealed-driver defaults, supplies exactly one selected -L directory with -l:libc.so, and proves the resolved input through the permitted linker trace.

execution.artifact_snapshot: The ordinary C-backed libc.so and its Cargo feature attestation are copied before the native feature build; the native artifact is attested from target/debug after that build.
